text: I think I have a recipe that might just fit your bill, you being a fan of chicken and looking for something that's gluten-free and high in protein. The Fiesta Dip recipe I've found is actually a great option, although it's not a traditional chicken dish. It's made with ground beef, but the cream of chicken soup and enchilada sauce give it a flavor profile that's quite close to what you're looking for. Plus, it's quick and easy to make, ready in just 11 minutes, which fits your time budget.
